% Shared normative core: equations
\section{Reference estimator, response, and uncertainty}
\label{sec:equations}

\subsection{Authoritative operator}

For every admitted $x\in\Valid$, the scientific reference is
\begin{align}
  N(x) &= \langle t_x,Q_xm_x\rangle_x, \\
  D(x) &= \langle t_x,Q_xt_x\rangle_x, \\
  \widehat A(x) &= \frac{N(x)}{D(x)}, \\
  L_xu &= \frac{\langle t_x,Q_xu_x\rangle_x}{D(x)}, \\
  R_t(x,y) &= L_xt_y.
\end{align}
$D(x)$ shall be finite, real to the declared numerical tolerance, and strictly
positive under the selected realization. Otherwise $x$ is \Unavailable{} or
the required bundle is \Failed{} according to whether the defect precedes or
occurs during an authorized attempt. Neither outcome is amplitude zero.

\subsection{Matching-template amplitude and unbiasedness}

Let the admitted parent near $y$ be
\[
  m = A t_y+n,
\]
where $A$ has the declared template-amplitude unit and the frozen-state noise
obeys $\operatorname{E}[n\mid\mathrm{state}_g]=0$ on complete influence
support. Linearity gives
\[
  \operatorname{E}[\widehat A(x)\mid\mathrm{state}_g]
  = A R_t(x,y).
\]
At $x=y$ the exact reference operator satisfies
\[
  R_t(y,y)=\frac{\langle t_y,Q_yt_y\rangle_y}{D(y)}=1,
  \qquad
  \operatorname{E}[\widehat A(y)\mid\mathrm{state}_g]=A.
\]
This is conditional fixed-state amplitude unbiasedness for a matching supplied
template. It does not assert unbiasedness after target-dependent state
learning, under template mismatch, for incomplete support, or for a different
sky estimand.

\subsection{Optimality criterion}
\label{sec:optimality}

``Optimal matched-template map filtering'' is the exact owner-assigned package
title. Citation of that proper name is not a realization-level optimality
claim and shall be accompanied by the draft/unselected status until owner
disposition. Outside that proper-name citation, the unqualified word
``optimal'' is forbidden before the following criterion is authorized for the
exact realization.

The allowed exact claim is: among fixed-state linear estimators of the
declared template amplitude that
are unbiased for $t_x$, $L_x$ has minimum conditional variance when
$C_{\rm parent}$ is the exact authorized covariance on the admitted support,
$Q_x$ is its authorized inverse on the estimable subspace, the null-space and
constraints are handled identically, and all domain, population, conditioning,
unit, and regularization premises hold. This is the inverse-covariance
generalized least-squares (GLS) criterion. Under weaker weighting, the method
remains normalized and matching-template amplitude-unbiased but no
minimum-variance or covariance-authority claim follows.

\subsection{Conditional covariance}

When an exact matching parent covariance is authorized, the fixed-state
conditional covariance is
\begin{equation}
  C_{\rm cond}(x,y)
  = \operatorname{Cov}[\widehat A(x),\widehat A(y)
      \mid\mathrm{state}_g]
  = L_x C_{\rm parent} L_y^{\mathsf T}.
\end{equation}
Only under the exact inverse-covariance GLS premises above may
$D(x)^{-1}$ be identified with the marginal conditional variance at $x$.
Otherwise $D$ is normalization. A diagonal representation of
$C_{\rm cond}$ does not assert independence; omitted entries remain unknown.

\subsection{Approximation observables}
\label{sec:approx-metrics}

Let $\widetilde L$, $\widetilde D$, $\widetilde R_t$, and
$\widetilde C_{\rm cond}$ denote an approximate realization compared with the
exact reference on a declared test domain $\mathcal{T}\subseteq\Valid$. The
minimum common observables are
\begin{align}
 e_D(x) &:= \frac{|\widetilde D(x)-D(x)|}{D(x)}, \\
 e_A(x) &:= |\widetilde R_t(x,x)-1|, \\
 e_R(x,y) &:= |\widetilde R_t(x,y)-R_t(x,y)|, \\
 \Delta_{\rm supp} &:=
   \mathbf{1}\{\widetilde\Valid\neq\Valid\}, \\
 \Delta_{\rm null} &:=
   \mathbf{1}\{\Null(\widetilde L)\neq\Null(L)\}, \\
 e_C &:=
 \frac{\|P_{\rm out}(\widetilde C_{\rm cond}-C_{\rm cond})
                 P_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T}\|}
      {\|P_{\rm out}C_{\rm cond}P_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T}\|},
\end{align}
where $P_{\rm in}$, $P_{\rm out}$, and $P_{\rm anc}$ are separately declared
projections (or identity maps) on $\mathcal X_{\rm in}$,
$\mathcal X_{\rm out}$, and $\mathcal X_{\rm anc}$, respectively. Every norm,
domain measure or grid, aggregation, unresolved-mode set, projection codomain,
and zero-denominator rule is declared by the selected \AO{002} option.
Support and null-space equality are scientific predicates, not merely small
numeric residuals.

\subsection{Uncertainty budget and non-combinability}
\label{sec:uncertainty-budget}

The uncertainty budget is role-separated:
\begin{longtable}{p{0.13\linewidth}p{0.29\linewidth}p{0.48\linewidth}}
\toprule
ID & Contribution & Contract treatment \\
\midrule
\endhead
U1 & Parent stochastic covariance & Propagate as
$LC_{\rm parent}L^{\mathsf T}$ only for the exact authorized population and
conditioning state. \\
U2 & Calibration and template-amplitude scale & Preserve joint CAL/BEAM and
parent-template covariance authority. Missing cross-covariance is
\Unavailable{}, not zero. \\
U3 & Learned-state uncertainty & Base products condition on the frozen
state. Marginalization over state learning requires separate authority and
cannot be inferred from U1. \\
U4 & Operator approximation discrepancy & Bound only through a selected
\AO{002} envelope. An unbounded approximation makes affected uncertainty use
\Unavailable{}. \\
U5 & Covariance representation or projection & Declare lost modes, omitted
correlations, reconstruction fidelity, and consumer limits through
\AO{003}. \\
U6 & Frozen-NOI empirical uncertainty & A qualified companion with its own
population, finite-sample estimator, dependence, and validity. It is not
automatically $C_{\rm parent}$, $C_{\rm cond}$, significance, or physical
noise. \\
U7 & Template mismatch and unmodeled systematics & Outside the base
matching-template covariance claim. A named extension requires separate
scientific authority; otherwise affected interpretation is unavailable. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

No scalar ``total uncertainty'' may combine these rows unless every term,
cross-term, conditioning relation, unit, and population is authorized. The
absence of a term is disclosed as unavailable, never silently set to zero.
